group_assessment.weighting: Observation weighted HIGH for what this laboratory actually does - LPS sepsis modelling, murine severity scoring, brain immunohistochemistry - and this is its own instrument set, not a borrowed one. Interpretation weighted LOW wherever the paper speaks about WWOX biology or about the P47T model's baseline: three specific failures show the cost of the inexperience, and all three concern the cited source rather than the new data - the GSEA comparator is misstated as heterozygous littermates when the source sequenced only WT/WT versus homozygotes, the GSEA is attributed in the Discussion to a 2014 review rather than to the 2023 mouse paper, and the baseline-equivalence premise is inherited from a paper whose own panels qualify it. This is the predicted shape for an adjacent laboratory reading someone else's model: the sepsis measurements are theirs and are sound to the extent their statistics allow, the WWOX framing around them is second-hand.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE CORTICAL MICROGLIA CLAIM IS CARRIED BETWEEN GENOTYPES AND NOT ACROSS TREATMENT: Fig. 3B prints 0.0282 for WT/WT-LPS versus WT/P47T-LPS, which is what the text says - and it also prints 0.6329 for wild type's own LPS response and 0.1206 for the heterozygote's, neither significant, with the PBS genotype contrast at 0.1165. So a significant genotype difference under LPS sits on top of no demonstrated LPS induction in either arm, and the Discussion's 'more severe neuroinflammation IN RESPONSE TO LPS' is stronger than the panel.

entries.proposition: THE PLASMA PANEL INVERTS THE BRAIN STORY, AND NOT ONE OF THE SIX CYTOKINES MEASURED DIFFERS BETWEEN GENOTYPES: under the bracket layout this figure actually uses, the between-genotype (LPS vs LPS) values are 0.2778 (IL-6), 0.2557 (TNF-alpha), 0.3940 (MCP-1), 0.9279 (IFN-gamma), 0.7772 (IL-12p70) and ns (IL-10) - every one non-significant. The SIGNIFICANT plasma LPS responses for IL-6 (0.0168) and TNF-alpha (0.0025) are WILD TYPE's, while the heterozygote's own responses for those two cytokines are non-significant (0.5314 and 0.1469); the heterozygote's own significant responses are MCP-1 (0.0027) and IFN-gamma (0.0430). A systemically MORE inflamed heterozygote is not what this figure shows - if anything the heterozygote mounts the weaker measured cytokinaemia while scoring as more severely septic. 🔴 THE BRACKET LAYOUT DIFFERS FROM FIGURES 3-9 and that is the trap: here the lower-left bracket is each genotype's own wild-type LPS response, the TOP bracket is the heterozygote's own response, and the right bracket is the between-genotype comparison. The mapping is pinned independently of bracket geometry by the printed PDF legend for S1C and S1D.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Suppl Fig 1, six panels S1A-S1F, each with four x-axis groups in the order WT/WT PBS, WT/P47T PBS, WT/WT LPS, WT/P47T LPS. Bracket layout: lower-left bracket spans group 1 to group 3 (WT/WT PBS vs LPS); top bracket spans group 2 to group 4 (WT/P47T PBS vs LPS); right bracket spans group 3 to group 4 (LPS vs LPS). Printed values - S1A Plasma IL-6: 0.0168, 0.5314, 0.2778. S1B TNF-a: 0.0025, 0.1469, 0.2557. S1C MCP-1: <0.0001, 0.0027, 0.3940. S1D IFN-g: 0.1843, 0.0430, 0.9279. S1E IL-12p70: 0.4659, 0.8591, 0.7772. S1F IL-10: three brackets all ns. The printed legend on the same page attributes the plasma MCP-1 increase to BOTH genotypes - p=<0.0001 for Wwox WT/WT and p=0.0027 for Wwox WT/P47T - with no between-group difference in S1C, which is only consistent with the layout described above; and for S1D it states, in one contiguous sentence: 'Wwox WT/P47T demonstrated an increase in plasma IFN-g in response to LPS (p=0.0430) while there was no significant LPS effect in the Wwox WT/WT groups'. Together these pin the bracket mapping without relying on bracket endpoints.

contradicts_locator.what_changed: Six printed p-values in three interchanged pairs were assigned to the wrong comparisons across S1A, S1B and S1E. Supplemental Figure 1 uses a DIFFERENT bracket layout from Figures 3-9: the lower-left bracket spans groups 1->3 (wild type's own LPS response), the TOP bracket spans groups 2->4 (the heterozygote's own response) and the right bracket spans 3->4 (between genotypes under LPS), whereas in Figs 3-9 the two lowest brackets are the adjacent pairs. Under the correct layout the between-genotype values are 0.2778, 0.2557, 0.3940, 0.9279, 0.7772 and ns, and the values previously offered as between-genotype (0.5314, 0.1469, 0.8591) are the heterozygote's own LPS responses. THE CONCLUSION IS UNCHANGED and was independently re-verified: every between-genotype comparison is non-significant, and the significant plasma IL-6 and TNF-alpha responses are wild type's. What was wrong is the evidence offered for it, in a proposition whose whole point is which genotype a number belongs to.

verdicts: blind locator audit, 2026-09-13, task ALDAZ-REPAIR-A-20260913: a separate agent with no session history received only (proposition, quote, anchor) triples plus the artefacts. It verified all six panels, all 18 bracket values and the group order from the pixels, confirmed the bracket-to-comparison mapping is exactly what the panels draw, and confirmed the layout genuinely differs from the main figures. Verdict SUPPORTED / EQUIVALENT on the repaired entry.

verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: WAIVED FOR 33 OF 36 ENTRIES, BY CLASS, AND THE THREE THE ABSTRACT CAN CARRY INSTEAD CARRY A VERIFIED `abstract_snippet` (entries 13, 15, 21). This source is not full-text indexed, so an external checker sees only its abstract - a 1,128-character summary containing NO numbers beyond the 10 mg/kg LPS dose and the 12-hour endpoint, no p-value, no n, no citation and no negative result. The waived entries fall into five classes and each entry states its own argument in `abstract_anchoring_note`: (1) DESIGN AND PROVENANCE - who donated the line, whose IACUC approved it, which genotyping assay, n per group, the seven ROUT exclusions and their asymmetry, the test choice, and the absence of any blinding statement: the abstract names none of these, because compressing them away is what an abstract does; (2) CITATION DEFECTS - the misstated GSEA comparator and its misattribution to a 2014 review: the abstract cites nothing at all, so a citation defect cannot be anchored in it; (3) SPECIFIC RESULT CONTRASTS - which arms were compared and what the comparison returned, where the abstract offers one unquantified clause; (4) NEGATIVES - the hippocampal astrocyte null, the neuronal-fraction null, the inverted peripheral cytokine pattern and the authors' own limitations, none of which appear in the abstract, their absence being exactly why the waiver is required; (5) FIGURE ATTESTATIONS - printed p-values, the pairs a bracket spans, fitted slopes, and the single-layer extraction artefact: these are pixel facts, and no abstract sentence can attest what a panel prints. Anchoring any of them to the abstract would attach a precise proposition to a sentence that omits precisely the qualification the locator exists to record.
